plan.goal: Filter point features to retain only those with image_date year >= 2013
plan.notes: Extract the year from the image_date string field (format appears to be 'YYYY-M' like '2022-9') and filter for year >= 2013. Keep all geometry (Point) and attribute fields. The filtered layer will feed IDW interpolation.

plan.goal: Perform Inverse Distance Weighted (IDW) interpolation on filtered points to create a 10 m resolution DEM raster
plan.notes: Use elevatio_1 as the interpolation field. Set raster cell size to 10 meters. Output extent should cover the full extent of the filtered points (bounds ~607111-611687 X, ~237963-240843 Y in EPSG:6569). Save as GeoTIFF.
